dialogues.speaker: Little Mao
dialogues.text: We're here, this is the Jademouth!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Such a huge hunk of jade, and even the other pieces on it are massive! Whoever it was that threw it down, adeptus or not, must have been absolutely titanic!

dialogues.speaker: Little Mao
dialogues.text: Hehe, adepti come in all shapes and sizes. "They could be as tall as the clouds, or small enough to hide amidst pool and leaf..." Agh, how did the rest of it go again... anyway, you get the picture! To sum up, adepti rule!
